notes: Step 1 parts were correct; no parts added or dropped.

Buzzer legs sit in breadboard columns 5 and 8 of the half the image draws at the top. The catalogue names that half bank 't' (rows a-e), so ports are 5t.* and 8t.*. The image's own row letters (f-j) differ from the catalogue's.
The exact row within each column strip does not matter, because all five holes of a strip are one node.

Left buzzer leg (column 5) goes by black wire to Uno GND, the GND next to AREF, so it is the negative leg, pin 1. Right leg (column 8) goes by red wire to digital pin 8, so it is the positive leg, pin 2. This matches the schematic (+ to pin 8, - to GND).
No series resistor, as in the tutorial's circuit and schematic; the piezo is driven directly by tone() on pin 8.
